guides.title: Box Breathing
guides.description: A simple technique to calm your nervous system.
steps: Sit comfortably with your back straight.
Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold your breath for a count of 4.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of 4.
Hold your breath for a count of 4.
Repeat for 5-10 minutes.

guides.title: Mindful Observation
guides.description: A guided meditation to bring awareness to the present moment.
steps: Find a quiet place to sit or lie down.
Close your eyes and take a few deep breaths.
Bring your attention to the sounds around you. Notice them without judgment.
Shift your attention to the physical sensations in your body.
Focus on your breath, feeling the rise and fall of your chest.
If your mind wanders, gently guide it back to your breath.
Continue for 10-15 minutes.

guides.title: Gentle Morning Stretches
guides.description: A sequence of simple yoga poses to start your day.
steps: Start with Cat-Cow pose to warm up your spine.
Move into Downward-Facing Dog, pedaling your feet.
Step forward into a low lunge on each side.
Come to a seated position and do a gentle spinal twist.
Finish with a few moments in Child's Pose.

guides.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
guides.description: Engage your senses to anchor yourself in the present.
steps: Take a deep breath. Look around you and name 5 things you can see.
Name 4 things you can feel. (e.g., the texture of your clothes, the surface you're sitting on).
Name 3 things you can hear. Listen for sounds both near and far.
Name 2 things you can smell. If you can't smell anything, name your 2 favorite smells.
Name 1 thing you can taste. You can take a sip of water or just notice the taste in your mouth.

guides.title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
guides.description: Release physical tension by tensing and relaxing muscle groups.
steps: Sit or lie down comfortably.
Tense the muscles in your toes for 5 seconds, then relax completely.
Move up to your calves, tensing and relaxing.
Continue this process up through your body: thighs, abdomen, chest, arms, hands, neck, and face.
Breathe deeply and notice the feeling of relaxation throughout your body.
End by shaking out your limbs gently.

guides.title: Mindful Walking
guides.description: Connect with your body and surroundings with a short, mindful walk.
steps: Find a space where you can walk back and forth for 10-15 paces.
Walk at a natural, comfortable pace.
Pay attention to the sensation of your feet on the ground.
Notice the subtle movements in your ankles, knees, and hips.
When your mind wanders, gently bring your focus back to the sensation of walking.
There's no goal or destination; simply be present with each step.
